note: Hand-written stand-in for a model response so the demo runs without an API key. Re-record with --llm record.

output.explanation: The capture route marked the order paid whenever the order-level status was COMPLETED. PayPal reports the order as COMPLETED even when the capture inside it is PENDING (funds not credited yet) or DECLINED. The route now reads purchase_units[0].payments.captures[0].status and only marks the order paid on COMPLETED; PENDING is recorded as pending and anything else as declined.
